The value of the temperature change of dry air or unsaturated moist air is called the dry adiabatic lapse rate. After the air becomes saturated, because the air temperature continues to decrease during ascent, precipitation releases heat energy to compensate for the cooling.

<image1>

If the figure shows the cooling condition of the windward slope of a certain mountain, then what is the approximate height at which precipitation begins to appear?
